workarounds.symptom: skill-retrieval: _skill_should_show() takes 3 positional arguments but 4 were given on Hermes v0.20.5 (index fails to build)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(skill-retrieval): support 3-arg _skill_should_show on Hermes ≤0.20.x (#14). Target files: plugins/skill-retrieval/scripts/bm25_retriever.py, plugins/skill-retrieval/tests/test_issue14_should_show_arity.py. - BM25 index build crashed on Hermes v0.20.5 with \`_skill_should_show() takes 3 positional arguments but 4 were given\` (issue #14). The plugin calls the host function with a 4th \`platform_hint\` argument; v0.20.x ships a 3-arg signature. \`plugin.yaml\` declares \`hermes_compatibility: >=0.20.0\`, so both... (Ref: https://github.com/moonlight-lupin/agent-skills/pull/17)
